context_for_next_testing_agent: Medical certificates archive feature is fully working. The archive is currently empty (0 certificates) which is expected - certificates are automatically archived when: 1) Athlete uploads new certificate via /athletes/upload-medical-certificate, 2) Certificate is updated via /certificates/upload-self. The archive stores: athlete name, team, issue date (12mo before expiry), expiry date, certificate data (base64), upload timestamp. Stats endpoint shows by_year counts. All previous UI fixes (documents, payments) verified working.
